title: Model a file system with files and folders
description: File and Folder both implement FileSystemItem. File is a leaf — it has a fixed size. Folder is a composite — it holds child FileSystemItems and its getSize() is the sum of all children's sizes, recursively. Implement File and Folder so that a tree of any depth can be traversed uniformly through the FileSystemItem interface.
hints: File stores a name and a size and returns them directly
Folder stores a list of children; getSize() sums each child's getSize() recursively
issues: Without a common interface, callers must distinguish between files and folders at every level
Computing a folder's total size requires type-checking and special-casing rather than simple recursion
overallGoal: Use the Composite pattern so that files and folders are treated identically through FileSystemItem, enabling recursive size calculation over a tree of arbitrary depth.
goals: File.getSize() returns its own fixed size
Folder.getSize() returns the total size of all descendants recursively
Both File and Folder are usable wherever a FileSystemItem is expected
